Retrieves all tags associated with the specified category external ID.
Please use [GET /v2/categories/{categoryExternalId}/tags](#/Tag%20Integration%20API/getPagedTagsByExternalCategoryId) instead.

info.name: List paginated tags by external category id

params.name: categoryExternalId
params.description: External identifier of the tag category

params.name: cursor
params.description: The reference point to fetch a set of results. If omitted or empty, the first page of results will be returned

params.name: size
params.description: Number of items per page (default value: 1000, min value: 1, max value: 10000)

items.docs:
Retrieves a paginated collection of tags associated with the specified category external ID.
Pagination is defined by cursor and size.
If the cursor is omitted, the first page will be returned.
If the size is omitted, a default size of 1000 will be used
